name: Auto Organize Coding Solutions

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'Coding/incoming/**'
    branches:
      - TEST

jobs:
  organize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Run Organizer Script
        run: |
          python -c "
          import os
          import shutil

          BASE_DIR = os.getcwd()
          INCOMING_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, 'Coding', 'incoming')

          def get_tech_stack(file_extension):
              ext = file_extension.lower()
              if ext in ['.sql', '.prc', '.pls']:
                  return 'sql'
              if ext in ['.py']:
                  return 'python'
              if ext in ['.cpp', '.java', '.go', '.js', '.ts']:
                  return 'dsa'
              return 'misc'

          if os.path.exists(INCOMING_DIR):
              for root, dirs, files in os.walk(INCOMING_DIR):
                  for file in files:
                      if file == 'README.md' and root == INCOMING_DIR:
                          continue
                      
                      file_path = os.path.join(root, file)
                      rel_path = os.path.relpath(root, INCOMING_DIR)
                      
                      _, ext = os.path.splitext(file)
                      if ext != '.md':
                          tech_stack = get_tech_stack(ext)
                          target_dir = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, 'Coding', tech_stack, rel_path)
                          os.makedirs(target_dir, exist_ok=True)
                          
                          for item in os.listdir(root):
                              s_item = os.path.join(root, item)
                              d_item = os.path.join(target_dir, item)
                              if os.path.exists(s_item):
                                  shutil.move(s_item, d_item)
                                  
              shutil.rmtree(INCOMING_DIR, ignore_errors=True)
          "

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@://github.com"
          git add Coding/
          git diff --quiet && git diff --staged --quiet || (git commit -m "Automated Sync: Sorted problem into designated tech stack folder" && git push origin TEST)
